evidence_status: PROPOSED DESIGN (dimensioned concept); masses and clearances CALC; nothing built or measured
note_mass: plus about 2.5 g for the larger front sleeve (CALC, 1.3 g/cm3)

components.label: Ball tip
components.function: The point that touches the paper and writes.
components.part: ISO 12757-2 D1 mini refill

components.label: Ink refill (D1 mini)
components.function: Standard replaceable refill; it slides along its axis on a soft constant-force spring so the ball stays on the paper while the nose tilts.
components.part: ISO 12757-2 D1 mini refill

components.label: Constant-force refill spring
components.function: Presses the refill onto the paper with about 0.15 N while the refill slides about 13.5 mm (tilt 35-75 deg and the tip's corrections).
components.part: custom constant-force strip spring, about 0.15 N (to size with a spring supplier)

components.label: Moving nose (refill carrier)
components.function: Thin titanium tube that holds the refill; it tilts on the gimbal so the tip moves up to about 3 mm against the handle.
components.part: custom (Ti-6Al-4V tube 7/6 mm)

components.label: Nose nozzle
components.function: Front of the moving nose; guides the refill tip.
components.part: custom (PEEK)

components.label: Rear arm
components.function: Carries the magnets behind the gimbal: the tip moves the opposite way, 1/lever times the magnet motion.
components.part: custom (aluminium 6061)

components.label: Magnet hub
components.function: Square hub on the arm carrying four magnets.
components.part: custom (soft iron)

components.label: Actuator magnet (y-force)
components.function: NdFeB magnet on the moving arm; the coil facing it pushes it sideways (shear), tilting the nose.
components.part: NdFeB N45 block 3.0 x 6.5 x 2.8 mm

components.label: Actuator magnet (y-force)
components.function: NdFeB magnet on the moving arm; the coil facing it pushes it sideways (shear), tilting the nose.
components.part: NdFeB N45 block 3.0 x 6.5 x 2.8 mm

components.label: Actuator magnet (x-force)
components.function: NdFeB magnet on the moving arm; the coil facing it pushes it sideways (shear), tilting the nose.
components.part: NdFeB N45 block 3.0 x 6.5 x 2.8 mm

components.label: Actuator magnet (x-force)
components.function: NdFeB magnet on the moving arm; the coil facing it pushes it sideways (shear), tilting the nose.
components.part: NdFeB N45 block 3.0 x 6.5 x 2.8 mm

components.label: Position magnet
components.function: Tiny magnet at the end of the arm read by the 3-D Hall sensor.
components.part: supermagnete S-01-01-N

components.label: Flexure gimbal (2-axis)
components.function: Laser-cut spring-steel cross flexures: the nose tilts in two directions with no friction or backlash; stiff along the pen.
components.part: custom (301 full-hard or 17-7PH 0.1 mm, laser-cut)

components.label: Handle shell
components.function: The body you hold: 22 mm thick, easier to grip than a pencil.
components.part: PEEK or glass-filled nylon, 1 mm wall

components.label: Soft-iron ring (flux return)
components.function: Section of the shell over the coils made of soft iron: it closes the magnets' flux through the coils.
components.part: custom (soft iron / 1010 steel, nickel plated)

components.label: Flat voice coil (y-force)
components.function: Fixed flat coil with a soft-iron back plate; current through it pushes the magnet sideways.
components.part: custom (self-bonding 0.1 mm magnet wire, IEC class 155)

components.label: Flat voice coil (y-force)
components.function: Fixed flat coil with a soft-iron back plate; current through it pushes the magnet sideways.
components.part: custom (self-bonding 0.1 mm magnet wire, IEC class 155)

components.label: Flat voice coil (x-force)
components.function: Fixed flat coil with a soft-iron back plate; current through it pushes the magnet sideways.
components.part: custom (self-bonding 0.1 mm magnet wire, IEC class 155)

components.label: Flat voice coil (x-force)
components.function: Fixed flat coil with a soft-iron back plate; current through it pushes the magnet sideways.
components.part: custom (self-bonding 0.1 mm magnet wire, IEC class 155)

components.label: 3-D Hall position sensor
components.function: Reads the nose position in x and y about 10 000 times a second for the position servo.
components.part: TI TMAG5273 (3-D Hall, I2C) or DRV5055 x2

components.label: Control board
components.function: nRF54L15-class MCU with Bluetooth, two coil drivers with current sensing, charger and the IMU. Runs the tremor tracker and the servo.
components.part: nRF54L15 + 2 x DRV8214 + charger

components.label: Motion sensor (IMU)
components.function: Accelerometer and gyroscope: measures the hand's shake about 2000 times a second (feeds the tracker).
components.part: ST LSM6DSV16X

components.label: Rechargeable cell
components.function: EEMB LIR14500, 750 mAh.
components.part: EEMB LIR14500

components.label: Vibration cue motor
components.function: Gentle buzz cues (write bigger, slow down, check a word).
components.part: coin LRA 8 mm

components.label: USB-C port and button
components.function: Charging and on/off / mode button (side port so the rear cap stays free).
components.part: USB-C receptacle (mid-mount)

components.label: Rear cap
components.function: Closes the handle.
components.part: custom (PEEK)

components.label: Inertial module frame
components.function: Houses the moving tungsten mass, its coils and flexures.
components.part: custom (aluminium)

components.label: Tungsten reaction mass
components.function: A heavy slug pushed sideways by coils: its reaction steadies the whole pen against the shake.
components.part: Tungsten heavy alloy ASTM B777 class 3 (non-magnetic grade)

components.label: Reaction-mass coils
components.function: Four flat coils facing magnets on the slug (2 axes).
components.part: custom

components.label: Front sleeve (larger front)
components.function: Where the thumb, index and middle finger rest; its front is larger to hold the heel drive.
components.part: PEEK core + TPE overmould

components.label: Skid ring with wheel slot
components.function: Rests on the paper like the Rev H ring, but larger, with a slot at the bottom through which the drive wheel reaches the paper.
components.part: custom (PTFE-coated POM, contact radius 8.40 mm, open 120 deg on top)

components.label: Drive wheel with O-ring tyre
components.function: A 2 mm wheel that rolls on the paper: steered, it lets the pen move only along the letter; driven, it pushes the pen along it.
components.part: custom brass hub d 0.8 mm + NBR O-ring 0.8 x 0.6 mm (tyre); axle d 0.3 mm in jewel bearings

components.label: Steering fork and crown
components.function: Holds the wheel and turns it about the paper normal through its contact point; carries the crown gear, the axle bevel and a tiny magnet for the steering-angle sensor.
components.part: custom (hardened steel fork, brass crown gear module 0.1, bevel 2:1 to the axle)

components.label: Heel pod (sprung)
components.function: Bearing block for the fork, the two bevel pinions and the sensors; it hangs on a flexure so a 0.55 N preload presses the wheel onto the paper.
components.part: custom (PEEK housing, two jewel bearings)

components.label: Preload flexure
components.function: Leaf spring that lets the pod move 0.54 mm toward the paper and presses it with about 0.55 N; the ring takes any extra writing force.
components.part: custom (17-7PH leaf 0.1 mm, laser-cut)

components.label: Wheel-load sensor
components.function: Hall sensor that reads the flexure's bend: the wheel's load, which sets how much force can be used before the wheel slips.
components.part: linear Hall IC (DRV5055 class) + 1 mm magnet

components.label: Steering-angle sensor
components.function: Reads the wheel's heading from a magnet on the fork, right at the wheel (so shaft twist does not matter).
components.part: 3-D Hall IC (TMAG5273 class) + diametric magnet d 1 mm

components.label: Drive shaft
components.function: Thin steel shaft in a PTFE liner that carries the drive motor's turning to the heel pod.
components.part: custom (stainless shaft d 0.8 mm, PTFE liner d 1.2 mm; 40 deg bevel pinion at the pod)

components.label: Steering shaft
components.function: Thin steel shaft in a PTFE liner that carries the steering motor's turning to the heel pod.
components.part: custom (stainless shaft d 0.8 mm, PTFE liner d 1.2 mm; 40 deg bevel pinion at the pod)

components.label: Shaft keel
components.function: Ridge under the front sleeve (toward the paper) that houses the two shafts either side of the paper sensor.
components.part: PEEK / TPE, part of the sleeve moulding

components.label: Paper sensor (needed by the drive)
components.function: Optical sensor that sees the paper: it detects wheel slip (pen motion that the wheel did not make) and gives the page position.
components.part: optical flow sensor, to select (mouse-class performance as PMW3360: 1 kHz reports, 12 000 frames/s; its own package is too large)

components.label: Transfer gears
components.function: Two small spur-gear pairs that move each motor's output out to its shaft, around the gimbal.
components.part: module 0.1 spur gears (33 teeth, 1:1, centre distance 3.3 mm), brass

components.label: Wheel drive motor
components.function: Turns the wheel so the pen is pushed along the letter (up to about 0.5 N at the wheel).
components.part: Faulhaber 0620 B brushless DC, 6 x 20 mm (drive: bevel 2:1 at the wheel; steering: crown 2:1)

components.label: Steering motor
components.function: Turns the wheel's heading to follow the letter.
components.part: Faulhaber 0620 B brushless DC, 6 x 20 mm (drive: bevel 2:1 at the wheel; steering: crown 2:1)

components.label: Motor drivers
components.function: Two three-phase drivers with current sensing that set each motor's torque 2000 times a second.
components.part: 3-phase micro BLDC driver x2 (to select; DRV8311 class)
